dimensions.why_it_matters: Exactness matters because this repo already treats exact-tool discipline as a first-class behavior.
Final verified coding success is the most important direct measure of solving value for this repo.
dimensions.scoring_method: verified green rate on hidden coding tasks

dimensions.why_it_matters: The completed agent loop includes bounded repair, so repair lift must be measured explicitly.
dimensions.scoring_method: verified repair success rate within retry budget

dimensions.why_it_matters: Unsupported confident answers are operationally harmful in a system that values truthful blocked and abstain behavior.
Truthfulness here means staying within supported claims and citing required evidence.
dimensions.scoring_method: supported answer rate with valid required citations

dimensions.why_it_matters: The future system path depends on evidence-grounded retrieval rather than unsupported world-knowledge bluffing.
dimensions.scoring_method: retrieval-grounded supported answer rate with citation compliance

dimensions.why_it_matters: A candidate that is unstable or routinely blocked at runtime is not a serious main-path choice.
dimensions.measurement_source: bakeoff runtime execution logs and solve reports
dimensions.scoring_method: stable execution rate across protocol tasks

dimensions.why_it_matters: The agent loop needs parseable, machine-readable outputs and narrow patch behavior.
dimensions.measurement_source: agent solve reports and backend schema adherence checks

dimensions.why_it_matters: Cost and latency matter only in relation to verified success, not as raw speed theater.
dimensions.measurement_source: solve reports with verifier-loop timing and runtime accounting
dimensions.scoring_method: normalized cost and latency per verified success

dimensions.why_it_matters: The chosen main path must fit the intended Linux-first workstation trajectory rather than a vague future deployment story.
dimensions.measurement_source: deployment-info constraints plus actual workstation execution behavior
dimensions.scoring_method: pass/fail deployment fit plus graded workstation practicality

decision_notes: Public benchmark prestige is not a scoring dimension.
The custom base does not receive sentimental preference.
The 14B slot does not receive automatic preference for being larger.
tie_break_rules: If candidates are within five weighted points, prefer the better runtime fit and lower cost per verified success.
Do not break ties using public benchmark reputation.
